openings.claim: Transfer sideways load from seal friction to removable edge stops on two opposed rim saddles, while sharing closure pressure across padded contacts. This could retain position without the left-corner tightening that lifts the opposite corner.
openings.delta: Use the four strips as paired upper/lower saddle jaws, drilled only on strips; allocate six bolts and four pads to reversible jaw attachment and edge registration. Tether removable pieces with cord. Change the load carrier to hatch-edge bearing through saddles into the rim; release and remove both saddles for inspection. Attachment details depend on the actual rim envelope and bolt reach.
openings.prediction: Against the nearest rival, equally padded friction-only clamping with registration disengaged, engaged stops should reduce sideways displacement without requiring greater closure pressure. The rival predicts improved retention primarily from tighter clamping, potentially reproducing corner lift. A right-contact card tests whether retention depends on uniform seal seating.
openings.probe: First measure rim access, strip reach, bolt reach, hatch-edge engagement and removal clearance. Fabricate only if these permit non-damaging saddles within ninety minutes. Allocate twelve closure/pull trials: two friction-only trials, one ordinary and one disturbed; then ten opening/closure cycles with stops engaged, the tenth disturbed. Use identical marked closure settings and pull direction. Record displacement under 20 N, closed marked position, reopening time, corner lift and seal condition, within twenty observation minutes. Compare configurations only as a preliminary contrast; the rival receives no ten-cycle durability test.
assumptions: Rim undersides are accessible and supplied strips and bolts can form removable saddles; neither geometry nor bolt length is supplied.
Pads and stop contact can bear the load without permanent hatch/rim deformation or seal damage.

Defeat conditions include inaccessible attachment, obstructed opening, insufficient fabrication/observation capacity, displacement above 1 mm, reopening above 30 seconds, lost components or new seal tears. Meeting limits is unproven; stop immediately on damage.

assessment: One uncertain opening: a bounded prototype probe, not deployment. Supplied corner lift motivates separating positional restraint from uneven seal compression; unknown attachment geometry prevents a feasibility claim.
